Junior Software Developer – Back-End Digital Services (Enterprise Retailer) 
 Position Summary 
 Our client, a leading  enterprise retailer , is seeking a  Junior Software Developer  to join its Back-End Digital Services team. This role will support the development and maintenance of cloud-based applications, APIs, and digital services that power customer-facing and enterprise retail solutions. The ideal candidate is passionate about software development, modern engineering practices, and leveraging AI-assisted development tools to deliver high-quality solutions. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 
 Develop, test, and maintain back-end applications using  C# and .NET . 
 Build and support  RESTful APIs  and integrations that enable digital commerce and retail operations. 
 Collaborate with product, business, and engineering teams to deliver scalable technology solutions. 
 Support the deployment, monitoring, and enhancement of applications within the  Microsoft Azure  cloud environment. 
 Troubleshoot and resolve application issues while ensuring performance and reliability. 
 Participate in code reviews and contribute to development best practices. 
 Create and maintain technical documentation. 
 Utilize  AI-assisted coding tools  such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar platforms to improve development efficiency and code quality. 
 
 Qualifications 
 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience. 
 0-3 years of software development experience through work, internships, co-ops, or academic projects. 
 Experience with  C#, .NET, API development, and Azure Cloud technologies . 
 Familiarity with Git, source control, and Agile development methodologies. 
 Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. 
 Interest in modern software engineering practices, including AI-enabled development. 
 
 Technical Environment 
 
 C# / .NET 
 Microsoft Azure 
 REST APIs & Microservices 
 Git & Azure DevOps 
 AI-Assisted Development (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or similar) 
 
 This is an excellent opportunity to contribute to enterprise-scale retail technology platforms while growing expertise in cloud development, API engineering, and AI-enabled software development.
